basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Walkin

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post sits in the Department of Endocrinology, AIIMS Jodhpur, under Principal Investigator Dr Ravindra Shukla, Additional Professor & Head of the department. The ICMR-funded project is a single-arm trial of islet transplantation in Type 1 DM with a gene expression study. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: First Class Post-Graduate degree, including integrated PG degree, in Biotechnology / Life Sciences / Biochemistry / Microbiology / Cell Biology / Physiology / Zoology or a relevant subject; OR Second Class Post-Graduate degree, including integrated PG degree, in the above subjects with PhD. All educational, professional and technical qualifications must be from a recognised Board/University and be full-time. Qualifications may be relaxed for highly experienced, trained or reputed candidates only at the discretion of the Selection Committee. Degree Certificates or Provisional Pass Certificates are required; marksheets are not accepted in place of Degree Certificates as proof of essential qualification. Hands-on experience in primary or mammalian cell culture under strict aseptic conditions. Experience in islet isolation (human or animal), enzymatic tissue digestion, density-gradient separation or cell-based assays (GSIS, ELISA, viability staining, qPCR). Experience in laboratory management: equipment calibration, maintenance logs, inventory and biosafety. Research publications; skill in data analysis and scientific report writing. Desirable competencies listed are cell culture and islet biology, laboratory management and equipment upkeep, data analysis and research report writing, and teamwork in an on-call service. The age limit is 35 years. Age, education qualification and experience are considered till the critical date, 03.12.2026. Age relaxation of up to 5 years may be granted to deserving candidates with experience in a Government Research Organisation on ICMR projects, on a case-by-case basis, as per ICMR Rules. Experience should preferably be from a Government Organisation or recognised organisation and is counted after the date of completion of the Minimum Essential Qualification. Experience in the relevant field or area required for the project is considered. Persons working in Government, a Public Sector Undertaking or other research projects must produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is ₹ 56,000 + 20% HRA per month (~₹ 67,200). The notice also states that the salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits, as prescribed by ICMR and based on funds sanctioned for the project. The position is initially for 12 months. It may be extended for an additional 12 months as per project requirement and the performance appraisal of the personnel. The appointment is for 12 months or till further notice, whichever is earlier. The selected candidate is expected to join within 15 days of the offer of appointment. Either side may end the engagement with one month's notice, and the appointee must complete pending assignments before being relieved. Performance is monitored regularly and the engagement may be terminated if it is deemed deficient. TA/DA for project travel may be reimbursed as per ICMR and Institutional Rules and the terms of the funds granted.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: The appointee works in the Islet Isolation Laboratory and GMP facility, Department of Endocrinology, AIIMS Jodhpur, in the team that isolates and manufactures human islets for transplantation, in coordination with the PI. Duties listed in the notice: Receipt of the donor pancreas under cold chain and chain-of-custody documentation. Human islet isolation and manufacturing: pancreas trimming, ductal cannulation, collagenase perfusion, digestion (Ricordi method), density-gradient purification on the COBE 2991 cell processor, islet culture and final product preparation. Islet quality testing: islet count (IEQ), purity (dithizone), viability (FDA/PI), glucose-stimulated insulin secretion, and sampling for sterility, endotoxin and gene expression. Working in the clean room (Grade A/B) as per GMP/GLP; preparation and quality control of media, enzymes and reagents. Contemporaneous documentation in batch manufacturing records, logbooks and SOP-based forms (ALCOA+). Laboratory maintenance, calibration and maintenance logs of equipment, clean-room environmental monitoring, inventory and indenting of consumables, and biomedical waste management. Research reports: analysis of islet quality and gene-expression data, laboratory reports, progress reports to ICMR and draft manuscripts. Gene-expression work (RNA extraction, cDNA synthesis, qPCR) on islet and patient samples as per protocol. On-call duty: islet isolation depends on the availability of a donor pancreas, which can be offered at any hour. The incumbent must be available on call 24 × 7, including nights, Sundays and holidays, and be able to report at short notice and work through an isolation that can last 10–14 hours. No additional remuneration is payable for on-call or extended duty.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can walk in and submit their application in the prescribed format by the deadline of 03.12.2026 (10.00 AM). The prescribed application form is printed at the end of the notice. The notice does not name a website for submitting it. Fill the "Application for Research Project Human Resource Position" form in capital letters, naming the post as Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical). Report on 03.12.2026 at 09:30 AM at the Department of Endocrinology, Room / Seminar Hall, AIIMS Jodhpur, Basni Industrial Area Phase 2, Jodhpur 342005. Carry a printout of the filled form, all relevant original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies and a CV/Brief Profile. Arrange at least one letter of recommendation in the prescribed format, sent directly by the referee from an official email ID to [email protected] by 03.12.2026, or brought in a sealed envelope signed across the flap. Submit a separate application for each post if applying for more than one post in this project. Documents named in the notice and its form: Birth Certificate / proof of date of birth and identity proof. Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/OBC). Higher Secondary, UG, PG and PhD degree certificates; UG and PG marksheets; additional qualifications. CV / Brief Profile and experience certificates. No Objection Certificate, where applicable. Details of two referees on the form (a co-author of a published paper, or the PI/Head of a previous laboratory, not a relative). Queries: Shailesh Bhagat, email [email protected] , mobile 9923521954. The notice states that no enquiries are entertained after the due date.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has a written screening test (only when needed) and an evaluation of 100 marks. If more than 5 eligible candidates report, a written screening test is held for 75 minutes. Section A has 20 MCQs. Section B is an essay on a research/laboratory report from hypothetical cell culture data, for 20 marks. Up to the top 5 are shortlisted for evaluation. If 5 or fewer eligible candidates report, all proceed to evaluation and the written test is taken without a cut-off. Evaluation covers the written test, credentials, letters of recommendation and the personal interview. The notice does not print the marks for each component. Each letter of recommendation is scored out of 5 marks. A missing, unsigned, unverifiable or related-referee letter scores 0, and the Selection Committee may contact the referees. The PI reserves the right to shortlist candidates for the further selection process.
